subject: Decreasing goodness-of-fit as I add cubic/quadratic terms?

messages.author: 43ea05056f7a637f
messages.subject: Decreasing goodness-of-fit as I add cubic/quadratic terms?
parts:
I'm fitting a latent growth curve model as can be seen below. However, as I add additional terms, my CFI, TLI, & SRMR shows *worse* fit. How can this be? Am I modeling things wrongly? 

You can find the complete code here:
https://github.com/aronlindberg/latent_growth_classes/blob/master/lgc_analysis.R

And the data here:
https://github.com/aronlindberg/latent_growth_classes/blob/master/LGC_data500.csv

Any leads on what might be happening are appreciated!

Best,
Aron

# Fitting the linear latent growth curve model
 
model <- '
# intercept and slope with fixed coefficients
 i =~ 1*t03 + 1*t04 + 1*t05 + 1*t06 + 1*t07 + 1*t08 + 1*t09 + 1*t10 + 1*t11 + 1*t12
 s =~ 0*t03 + 1*t04 + 2*t05 + 3*t06 + 4*t07 + 5*t08 + 6*t09 + 7*t10 + 8*t11 + 9*t12
'
linear <- growth(model, data=latent.growth.data.formatted)

# Fitting the quadratic latent growth curve model

model <- '
# intercept and slope with fixed coefficients
 i =~ 1*t03 + 1*t04 + 1*t05 + 1*t06 + 1*t07 + 1*t08 + 1*t09 + 1*t10 + 1*t11 + 1*t12
 s =~ 0*t03 + 1*t04 + 2*t05 + 3*t06 + 4*t07 + 5*t08 + 6*t09 + 7*t10 + 8*t11 + 9*t12
 quad =~ 0*t03 + 1*t04 + 4*t05 + 9*t06 + 16*t07 + 25*t08 + 36*t09 + 49*t10 + 64*t11 + 81*t12
'
quadratic <- growth(model, data=latent.growth.data.formatted)

# Fitting the cubic latent growth curve model

model <- '
# intercept and slope with fixed coefficients
 i =~ 1*t03 + 1*t04 + 1*t05 + 1*t06 + 1*t07 + 1*t08 + 1*t09 + 1*t10 + 1*t11 + 1*t12
 s =~ 0*t03 + 1*t04 + 2*t05 + 3*t06 + 4*t07 + 5*t08 + 6*t09 + 7*t10 + 8*t11 + 9*t12
 quad =~ 0*t03 + 1*t04 + 4*t05 + 9*t06 + 16*t07 + 25*t08 + 36*t09 + 49*t10 + 64*t11 + 81*t12
 cube =~ 0*t03 + 1*t04 + 2^3*t05 + 3^3*t06 + 4^3*t07 + 5^3*t08 + 6^3*t09 + 7^3*t10 + 8^3*t11 + 9^3*t12
'
cubic <- growth(model, data=latent.growth.data.formatted)
